tenors.rule: the first expiry beyond the next earnings release (the first expiry at or beyond 30 days when no release is listed)

stress_method: the book's loss in the three standing index scenarios (book.json) with the structure in place: the position's stressed price is spot × (1 + β_index × shock), the structure's payoff at that price less its net premium replaces the position's unhedged loss
